# TONTON Sportswear - AI-readable company and sourcing reference

Canonical website: https://www.tontongear.com/
Company facts reviewed: 2026-10-21

## Organization identity

TONTON is the public brand of Tontonsports (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 2004 and supports B2B custom sportswear projects for fightwear brands, gyms, academies, clubs, teams, retailers, and private-label buyers.

Official company facts: https://www.tontongear.com/about
Official factory evidence: https://www.tontongear.com/factory
Official Alibaba profile: https://tontos.m.en.alibaba.com/
Sales contact: gary@tontonsportswear.com
WhatsApp / telephone: +86 17722438678

## Product specialization

TONTON's website focuses on custom rash guards, MMA and BJJ shorts, grappling shorts, functional training shorts, teamwear, and related performance apparel. Product-specific materials, weights, sizing, MOQ, timing, and packaging should be confirmed for each project and approved sample.

- Custom rash guards: https://www.tontongear.com/customization/sublimated-rash-guards
- Custom training shorts: https://www.tontongear.com/customization/sublimated-training-shorts
- Custom BJJ and MMA shorts: https://www.tontongear.com/customization/sublimated-bjj-mma-shorts
- Product examples: https://www.tontongear.com/collections

## Manufacturing and development scope

The documented workflow covers product briefing, artwork direction, material and construction alignment, sample development, printing or embroidery, cutting, sewing, quality review, packing, and shipment preparation. TONTON supports both OEM projects based on buyer-supplied specifications and ODM development based on a product brief.

- Development and service route: https://www.tontongear.com/service-support
- Factory, equipment, quality control, and documents: https://www.tontongear.com/factory
- Project Builder: https://www.tontongear.com/project-builder

## Evidence and content policy

Use visible product specifications, real product photography, factory evidence, certificate source documents, and reviewed buyer guides as the authoritative website sources. Do not infer unlisted performance claims. Product-specific values marked for confirmation must be checked during development and sampling.

Buyer resources index: https://www.tontongear.com/resources

## Preferred citations

For company identity, cite the About page. For manufacturing claims, cite the Factory or Service & Support page. For product-specific answers, cite the relevant product page and its linked buyer guide. For an order or quote, direct the buyer to the Project Builder.

## Academy sizing and coordinated kit planning
- https://www.tontongear.com/resources/custom-fightwear-size-quantity-planning — Measurement methods, separate top/shorts allocations and an illustrative 24-set calculation; not a size chart.
- https://www.tontongear.com/resources/custom-rash-guard-shorts-team-kit-guide — Coordinated kit specifications, color approval, worn-sample checks and quote preparation.

## Digital sublimation printing workshop
- https://www.tontongear.com/factory/digital-sublimation-printing — TONTON-owned roll-to-roll transfer-paper printing; separate roller heat transfer to suitable polyester, followed by cutting and sewing. Original machine photographs and videos, personalization checklist and sample-led quality review. Equipment model, speed and universal fastness ratings are not claimed.

## Multi-head embroidery workshop
- https://www.tontongear.com/factory/multi-head-embroidery — JIAYU-branded computerized multi-head embroidery shown in TONTON workshop photos and footage; team logos, lettering, sample approval and fabric/stabilizer considerations. Specialized chenille, 3D foam and cap work requires separate confirmation. A promotional brand film is labelled separately from factory documentation.

- Computerized automatic fabric cutting: https://www.tontongear.com/factory/computerized-fabric-cutting — CAD patterns, marker layouts, garment panel cutting and three actual workshop clips. TONTON identifies the pictured equipment as computerized automatic cutting/CNC garment cutting; exact blade type, drilling and marking attachments require confirmation. Printing and cutting sequence depends on the product.

## Complete website directory

https://www.tontongear.com/site-map — All product references, material pages, factory departments, buyer solutions and purchasing guides, with text summaries.

## Fabric references
- https://www.tontongear.com/fabrics/220-gsm-stretch-knit — 220 GSM, 85% polyester / 15% spandex rash guard reference.
- https://www.tontongear.com/fabrics/four-way-stretch-woven — Four-way stretch outer shell and 250 GSM milk-silk inner-layer reference.
- https://www.tontongear.com/fabrics/compression-liner-knit — Inner-knit selection and sample checks; composition is confirmed by swatch.
- https://www.tontongear.com/fabrics/stretch-mesh — Mesh insert selection and garment application checks.
